inclusion_rules.drug: parent-normalized ChEMBL molecule with max_phase >=2; exclude Cell, Gene, Vaccine component
inclusion_rules.target: human protein component with ChEMBL GENE_SYMBOL mapping present in frozen 15,165-gene canonical universe
inclusion_rules.mechanism_evidence: all curated drug_mechanism records mapped through human protein target components (single proteins, complexes, complex groups, families, and protein interactions); direct_interaction not required
inclusion_rules.bioactivity_evidence: binding assay, confidence_score=9, pChEMBL>=6, relation =/< /<=, standard_flag=1, no validity comment, not potential duplicate
inclusion_rules.deduplication: parent ChEMBL molecule x HGNC gene
inclusion_rules.fisher_background: frozen 15,165 canonical genes, identical for Bridge and DE
